value: High throughput legitimacy cannot make up for poor participation or poor performance, while poor procedural quality can undermine input or output legitimacy.
quote: The experience is that a high level of throughput legitimacy cannot make up for poor quality of citizen or stakeholder participation or for poor performance, but in contrast, poor procedural quality can jeopardize people’s granting of input or output legitimacy [ 225 ].
